need.role: Plays on the player character when the attack input is pressed, giving the punch visual weight.
need.constraints: R15-compatible single-arm jab or straight punch animation, non-looping, duration approximately 0.3-0.6 seconds, playable via AnimationController/Animator on the default player rig, timed to roughly align with hit registration.

intent.experienceRole: Provides the visual feedback of the player's attack action, making punches feel physical and readable so hits feel earned.
intent.interaction: Triggered the instant the player presses the attack input; plays once on the player's arm/torso during the punch swing, timed to align with hit detection on the dummy and the accompanying hit sound.
reusableFeatures: Any existing attack/punch animations already rigged to the player character
